The V-misread fixtures use whole-question deferred deduction when acceleration earns no A/B."

spans.before: "operational_rules": "Proposed MR03 operational rules, pending Vitalis approval of the exact manifest: decide and record eligibility once at first use; ineligible data remain canonical in every later part. For each eligible misread datum, first mark all gross evidence and dependencies, then deduct one mark from the first earned A/B on that datum in question/criterion order, moving to later-use parts if necessary. Deduct nothing only if no A/B is earned on the datum anywhere. Never deduct from M/DM or make the score negative. The selected criterion remains earned for every DM, dependency and www check; one datum costs at most one net mark. Eligible OD-6 follow-through overrides not-F.T. and c.a.o. restrictions, while correct working, named method exclusions and OD-1 still apply. No-solution exclusion means a misread removes a solution the canonical question has; a designed no-real-solution outcome remains eligible when its demand and difficulty are preserved.",
